planets.name: WASP-24 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-24 with a 2.34-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: WASP-24 b was found in 2010 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-24. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2010, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.3412202, pl_radj 1.38, pl_bmassj 1.24

quotes.title: WASP-24
quotes.card: WASP-24 is an F-type star with the hot Jupiter planet WASP-24b in orbit, about 1,075 light-years away in the constellation Virgo.
quotes.introduction: WASP-24 is slightly larger and more massive than the Sun, it also has a similar metallicity and is hotter than the Sun.
